Usage: zealakit recipe [options] [command]

Author external recipes (data-only folders with recipe.json)

Options:
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  init [options] <name>     Create a recipe folder with recipe.json, shared/,
                            scaffold/ and an agent skill
  validate [options] <dir>  Check a recipe folder: schema, no symlinks/code, and
                            staging against every compatible template
  help [command]            display help for command
